newsitem.title: POLAND: Flood to cost Polish social security PLN 854 mln.
newsitem.headline: Flood to cost Polish social security PLN 854 mln.

text.p: Two weeks of heavy floods will cost Poland's Social Security Office (ZUS) 854 million zlotys in premium reliefs, emergency benefits and costs of repairing its regional offices, ZUS president told a news conference.
"We have estimated that the flood will cost ZUS a total of 854 million zlotys this year," Anna Bankowska said on Monday.

She said 801 million zlotys or 5.2 percent of total three-months premium receipts, ZUS would lose due to various premium reliefs offered individuals and companies from the flooded regions for the June-August period.
She said that under special flood-relief law, ZUS would also pay about 36 million zlotys in child benefits to families that would normally not qualify.
Another 1.6 million will be spent on compensation for families of flood victims and 14.7 million zlotys on the reconstruction of ZUS offices damaged by the flood.
Bankowska said the lost premium receipts and extra flood-related payouts would be made up by subsidies from the state budget.
"ZUS's expenditure is financed by the state budget and the state's subsidies have been guaranteed," Bankowska said.
